styles: grim post-apocalyptic vehicle combat score, menacing and oppressive
100 BPM, D Phrygian, static root drone, no chord changes, steady tempo
huge dry tribal war drums, deep toms, junk metal and anvil hits, straight heavy march, no swing
fuzzy overdriven bass riff hammering the root
snarling muted horns and growling low trombone, short dissonant stabs, downward slides
raw dry lo-fi room recording, tape saturation

sections.text:
[Intro]
{tribal war drums pound alone, then the fuzz bass drone joins on the root}

[Verse]
{drums and fuzz bass hammer a one-bar ostinato on the root, sparse and menacing, the horns rest}

[Chorus]
{full force: muted horns and low trombone fire short dissonant stabs over the drums and bass, crash cymbals}

[Break]
{stop-time: one dissonant hit from the whole band on beat one of each bar, ringing, silence between the hits}

[Verse]
{drums and fuzz bass hammer a one-bar ostinato on the root, sparse and menacing, the horns rest}

[Chorus]
{full force: a growling low trombone ostinato with downward slides and flutter tongue over the drums and bass, crash cymbals}

[Solo]
{a buzzy analog synth lead fires fast pew pew laser runs in Phrygian and trades phrases with a screaming overdriven guitar over the drums and bass}

[Break]
{stop-time: one dissonant hit from the whole band on beat one of each bar, ringing, silence between the hits}

[Chorus]
{everything at once: horn stabs, trombone growls, drums and fuzz bass, crash cymbals, the biggest part}

[Outro]
{one final dissonant hit from the whole band on the root, ringing out to silence}
